hero.title: TrondheimDC
hero.subtitle: We run the TDC conference, and use the surplus to support the volunteer tech community in Trondheim the rest of the year.

about.title: What we do
about.p1: TDC is organised by a cross-section of tech communities in the Trondheim region. The goal is a non-commercial, volunteer-run conference where technology enthusiasts can learn from each other, share knowledge, and meet.
about.p2: Any surplus from the conference goes toward running next year's conference, and toward supporting events in Trondheim organised by different tech groups. Our bylaws explicitly state that the association shall support the local, volunteer-run IT community through financial support schemes.
about.p3: We have run the conference since 2012.

groups.title: Communities in Trondheim
groups.subtitle: An independent index of tech communities in the Trondheim region — not just the ones we fund.

addYours.title: Is your community missing?
addYours.body: Email us and we'll add you to the list.

stotte.title: Support for communities
stotte.intro: The association exists to support the local, volunteer-run IT community in the Trondheim region. Below are the criteria for what we can contribute to.
criteria: The event must take place in the Trondheim region.
The event must be free and open to anyone who wants to attend.
The event must have a clear focus on technology, design, or creativity, relevant to the TDC community.
stotte.closing: Get in touch by email and we'll figure it out together. Briefly describe the event — theme, audience, and what you'd like us to cover.
stotte.reimburseBody: Use our expense form to get reimbursed.

vedtekter.title: Bylaws
